cloud.description: Morpheus cloud (zone) VMs are created in. Set id or name.

id.description: Morpheus cloud (zone) ID. Leave 0 to select by name instead.

name.description: Morpheus cloud (zone) name, e.g. hvm.example.com. Accepts the object's code as well. Ignored when id is set.

group.description: Morpheus group (site) that owns the instance. Set id or name.

id.description: Morpheus group (site) ID. Leave 0 to select by name instead.

name.description: Morpheus group (site) name, e.g. Homelab. Accepts the object's code as well. Ignored when id is set.

instance_type.description: Optional. Narrows which layouts are considered when one layout name exists under more than one instance type. The layout still supplies the instance type used.

id.description: Optional. Leave 0 -- the layout supplies the instance type. Only set to disambiguate a layout name that exists under more than one instance type.

name.description: Optional. Leave empty -- the layout supplies the instance type. Only set to disambiguate a layout name that exists under more than one instance type.

instance_type_code.description: Optional. Leave empty -- the layout supplies the instance type. Same narrowing as instance_type, by the type's stable code.

layout.description: Library layout, which selects the hypervisor and supplies the instance type. Must be an MVM layout. Set id or name.

id.description: Layout ID. Leave 0 to select by name instead.

name.description: Layout name, e.g. Single HVM. Must be an MVM layout: it selects the hypervisor and supplies the instance type. Accepts the object's code as well. Ignored when id is set.

plan.description: Service plan sizing the instance. Set id or name.

id.description: Service plan ID. Leave 0 to select by name instead.

name.description: Service plan name or code, e.g. "4 CPU, 4GB Memory" or kvm-vm-4-4096. Sizes the instance. Ignored when id is set.

network.description: Network attached to the instance's primary NIC. Set id or name.

id.description: Network ID. Leave 0 to select by name instead.

name.description: Network name for the primary NIC, e.g. Compute VLAN 110. Accepts the object's code as well. Ignored when id is set.

resource_pool.description: Optional MVM compute pool. Leave unset to let Morpheus choose.

id.description: Optional. MVM compute pool ID. Leave 0 to select by name, or leave both unset to let Morpheus choose.

name.description: Optional. MVM compute pool name. Leave unset to let Morpheus choose.

datastore.description: Optional datastore ID, or 'auto'/'autoCluster' to let Morpheus choose.

image.description: Optional existing Morpheus virtual image. Leave unset to download and cache the required Talos image automatically from Talos Image Factory.

id.description: Optional. Existing Morpheus virtual image ID. Leave 0 to download and cache the Talos image automatically.

name.description: Optional. Existing Morpheus virtual image name. Leave unset to download and cache the Talos image automatically.

image_format.description: Image Factory artifact to import. qcow2 is native for MVM; raw is downloaded as raw.xz and decompressed by the provider.

os_type.description: Optional. Library OS type name or code recorded on imported images, e.g. linux. Leave empty to omit it; Morpheus does not require one and this provider disables the agent behaviour it would drive.

uefi.description: Firmware for imported images. Leave unset to use the platform default; the Talos nocloud image boots under either.

architecture.description: Machine architecture. Only amd64 is supported.

cores.description: Optional core count override. Only applied on a service plan that permits custom sizing; 0 uses the plan.

memory.description: Optional RAM override in MiB. Only applied on a service plan that permits custom sizing; 0 uses the plan.

disk_size.description: Optional boot disk size override in GiB. 0 uses the plan.
